predictor.notes: Best-supported parsimonious predictor for quantities 1..1000, in GBP pence. It matches both exact approvals (50: 154050; 200: 376400) and reproduces all 167 observed estimates under their disclosed quantization rules. Adjacent probes locate downward jumps at 168/169 and 506/507. Interval fitting supports these three proportional tiers without additional segments or quadratic terms. Conditional on proportional pricing, the third-tier rate is approximately 906.98276–907.10336 pence/unit, containing the single integer 907. Exact recovery is not uniquely identifiable: alternative affine formulas also satisfy the observations, and narrow unsampled deviations cannot be excluded. These coefficients are therefore the preferred validated model, not a proof of the hidden exact function.
